source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of gene linkage (PDF 100-102).

blocks.text: Jism ke cells hazaron genes mehdood chromosomes par rakhte hain: insan ke taqreeban 20,000 genes 23 chromosomes par (do set mein), aur phal ki makkhi Drosophila ke taqreeban 13,000 genes 4 chromosomes par (yeh bhi do set mein). Is liye har chromosome par bohat se genes aik qatar mein hote hain, kuch bohat qareeb qareeb.

blocks.title: Linked genes
blocks.text: Aik hi chromosome par maujood genes linked genes hain, aur ise gene linkage kehte hain. Qareeb linked genes ikatthe rehte aur gametes bante waqt azadana alag nahi hote, jab ke mukhtalif chromosomes par, ya aik chromosome par door door, genes azadana alag hote hain.
Linkage aur us ki shiddat crosses kar ke aur har phenotype ki ginti kar ke parhi jati hai, jis mein parental milap (walidain jaise) ka recombinant ya naye milapon se muqabla hota hai.

items: Parental aur naye phenotypes barabar 1:1:1:1: genes linked nahi aur azadana alag hote hain.
Parental milap zyada aur naye kam: incomplete linkage; genes linked hain lekin crossing over se alag ho sakte hain.
Sirf parental milap, koi naya nahi: complete linkage; genes bohat qareeb hain aur alag nahi hote.

blocks.text: American mahir-e-hayatiyat Thomas Hunt Morgan ne Drosophila mein paron ki lambai aur pait ki chaurai dekhi: lambe par (L) chhote ya vestigial paron (l) par dominant, aur chaura pait (B) patle (b) par dominant hai. Chaure pait aur lambe paron wali makkhi ko patle pait aur vestigial paron wali makkhi se milane par F1 makkhiyon ke lambe par aur chaure pait the, phir do F1 makkhiyan milayi gayin.

Independent assortment ke mutabiq F2 9:3:3:1 aur do naye milap (lambe par aur patla pait, vestigial par aur chaura pait) hone chahiye the. Morgan ne sirf parental milap dekhe: 3/4 lambe par aur chaura pait aur 1/4 vestigial par aur patla pait. Us ne nateeja nikala ke paron ki lambai aur pait ki chaurai ke genes aik hi chromosome par hain aur azadana alag nahi hote.

blocks.alt: Makkhiyon aur un ke chromosome joron (dairon mein) ke saath cross. Walidain: lambe par, chaura pait LLBB x vestigial par, patla pait llbb. Sab gametes mein L-B ya l-b. F1: do LlBb makkhiyon ka cross; har aik L-B aur l-b gametes banati hai. F2 genotypes: 1/4 LLBB, 1/4 LlBb, 1/4 LlBb, 1/4 llbb. F2 phenotypes: 3/4 lambe par chaura pait, 1/4 vestigial par patla pait.

blocks.title: Maloomat
blocks.text: Gene linkage sirf tab nazar aati hai jab cross bohat se bachche de: nasl jitni bari ho, utna hi zyada imkaan hai ke woh aabadi mein linkage ki asal shiddat dikhaye.

blocks.prompt: Testcross se dono parental qismein 42% har aik aur do nayi qismein 8% har aik aati hain. Yeh kya dikhata hai?
blocks.explanation: Parental qismein naye se kaheen zyada hain, is liye genes linked hain, lekin nayi qismein batati hain ke crossing over kabhi kabhi unhein alag karta hai: incomplete linkage.

items: Linked genes aik hi chromosome par aur ikatthe virasat mein jate hain.
1:1:1:1 linked nahi; parental > naye incomplete linkage; sirf parental complete linkage.
Morgan ka F2: sirf parental qismein, 3:1.
